news.title:
Gujarat Gas Ltd's board to meet on May 26, 2026, to review audited financial results and consider dividend.
Trading window closure from April 1 to May 28, 2026, per SEBI insider trading norms.

Gujarat Gas Ltd to merge with GSPC and GSPL, effective May 1, 2026.
GGL expands to gas trading, production, power, and City Gas Distribution.
Consensus revenue estimates increase by 118%
news.body: The consensus outlook for revenues in fiscal year 2027 has improved. 2027 revenue forecast increased from ₹172.2b to ₹375.2b. EPS estimate increased from ₹17.18 to ₹28.01 per share. Net income forecast to grow 22% next year vs 3.0% decline forecast for Gas Utilities industry in India. Consensus price target up from ₹417 to ₹444. Share price was steady at ₹401 over the past week.

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Higher Revenue Outlook And Dividend Support Measured Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target for Gujarat Energy from ₹418.11 to ₹444.46, citing updated assumptions that combine a higher revenue growth outlook with slightly lower profit margin forecasts, as well as a modestly higher future P/E multiple and discount rate. What's in the News The board has recommended a final dividend of ₹8.90 per equity share of ₹2 each for the financial year 2025 to 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹21.55 (up from ₹16.68 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹249.7b (up 52% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹20.2b (up 76% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 8.1% (up from 7.0% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 59%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 35%. Revenue is forecast to decline by 15% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, while revenues in the Gas Utilities industry in India are expected to remain flat. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 3% per year whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 5% per year.

news.title: Gujarat Energy Limited Recommends Final Dividend for Financial Year 2025-26 Ended March 31, 2026
news.body: Gujarat Energy Limited recommended a final Dividend of INR 8.90 per Equity Share of INR 2 each to the shareholders for the Financial Year 2025 - 26 ended March 31, 2026, which will be paid subject to approval of Shareholders in the Annual General Meeting.

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Upcoming Board Decision On Dividend Will Pressure Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have slightly reduced their price target for Gujarat Energy from ₹276.43 to ₹276.24, reflecting updated inputs for revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on May 26, 2026 to consider and approve the standalone and consolidated audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Lower Fair Value And Margins Will Pressure Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have revised their fair value estimate for Gujarat Gas to ₹276.43 from ₹340.00. This reflects updated views on revenue growth assumptions, profit margin outlook and future P/E expectations.

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Firmer Revenue Outlook And Higher P/E Will Support Positive Returns
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Gujarat Gas to ₹418 from ₹435, reflecting updated assumptions that combine slightly higher revenue growth expectations with more cautious views on profit margins and future P/E levels. Valuation Changes Fair Value: Trimmed from ₹434.89 to ₹418.11, a modest reduction in the central value estimate.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 17%
news.body: After last week's 17% share price gain to ₹368, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 21x. Average forward P/E is 15x in the Gas Utilities industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 18% over the past three years. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹424 per share.

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Tweaked Assumptions And Fair Value View Will Shape Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Gujarat Gas slightly from ₹345 to ₹340, reflecting updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E expectations. Valuation Changes Fair Value: Trimmed slightly from ₹345.0 to ₹340.0, a reduction of about 1.4%.

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Leadership Transition And Steady Margins Will Support A Positive Outlook
news.body: Analysts now place Gujarat Gas's price target at approximately ₹435, slightly below the prior fair value of about ₹438. This reflects updates to revenue growth assumptions, a broadly similar profit margin outlook, and a marginally higher future P/E estimate.

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Leadership Transition Will Support Earnings Visibility And Future Repricing Potential
news.body: Analysts have nudged their implied fair value estimate for Gujarat Gas slightly higher to about ₹564 from about ₹561, reflecting marginally different assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E expectations. What's in the News Managing Director Shri Milind Torawane, IAS (DIN: 03632394), has resigned from the Gujarat Gas board following his transfer and appointment as Principal Secretary to Government, Education Department (Primary & Secondary Education).

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Board Changes And Stable Margins Will Shape A Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Gujarat Gas by about ₹10, reflecting updated assumptions on fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples that point to a slightly more conservative outlook on the stock's valuation. What's in the News Managing Director Shri Milind Torawane, IAS (DIN: 03632394), has resigned from the Board of Gujarat Gas, effective 24 December 2025, following his transfer and appointment as Principal Secretary to Government, Education Department (Primary & Secondary Education) (Key Developments).

news.title: GUJGASLTD: Leadership Transition And Upcoming Results Will Support Earnings Visibility
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for Gujarat Gas slightly higher from ₹557.09 to ₹560.57, reflecting updated views on discount rates, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions. What's in the News Managing Director Shri Milind Torawane, IAS (DIN: 03632394), has resigned from the Board of Directors effective December 24, 2025, following his transfer and appointment as Principal Secretary to Government, Education Department, Primary & Secondary Education (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.88 (up from ₹3.21 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹36.6b (down 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.67b (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.3% (up from 5.3% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 4.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 9.8%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 2.0% decline forecast for the Gas Utilities industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 9% per year whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 4% per year.

news.title: Gujarat Gas Limited Appoints Shri B N Patel as Executive Director Effective January 21, 2026
news.body: Gujarat Gas Limited has appointed Shri B N Patel, GAS (Selection Scale) as Executive Director of Gujarat Gas Limited effective from January 21, 2026, as per the notification issued by General Administration Department, Government of Gujarat bearing number GAS/35.2026/03/G.1 dated January 19, 2026. Shri B N Patel has done graduation in mechanical engineering and LLB. After being selected by the State Public Service Commission, he joined Government of Gujarat as Mamlatdar in the year 2005 and after serving for a few years as Mamlatdar, in the year 2012 he was promoted to the cadre of GAS and worked under Panchayat Department and Revenue Department as Deputy District Development Officer and Deputy Collector respectively.
